[LSTO.2.4.1] **Must-not-lose.** A stored fact is durable against engine
restarts and tolerated delays. The storage service must assert a `CallError`
for every write it cannot make durable ([LCRS.17.1]); a rule can assume a
stored fact is durable unless a `CallError` says otherwise, and a rule that
must act on a lost write matches that `CallError`.
